description: S51 T1 (TM3), the forged-filer refusal on the wire: triage.file params carry "filedBy" — refused by KEY before the lenient decode (decodeParams ignores unknown keys, so the refusal lives here or nowhere; the roadmap identity-key precedent). Who filed a bug is now DERIVED from the stamped actor — 'person' for a person at the socket, the agent's own slug for its twin — and a param that carried a filer let anyone name anyone, the unchecked free-text filed_by this migration-closing removal ends. "actor" and "actorKind" carry the same refusal on every triage write.
